desc: The CZ 600+ Alpha is a modern hunting rifle designed for accuracy, durability, and versatility. Featuring a lightweight aluminum receiver with a sleek black finish, it delivers sub-MOA precision with match-grade factory ammunition. The rifle is equipped with a user-interchangeable barrel system, allowing quick caliber changes to adapt to different hunting and shooting needs. Its ergonomic synthetic stock offers weather resistance and all-day comfort, while the steel components are treated with a protective BobOx finish for long-lasting reliability. With a threaded muzzle, ambidextrous safety, and compatibility with Remington 700-style optic mounts, the CZ 600+ Alpha is built to perform in any condition.
